title: Hatsune Miku — Rooftop Chat〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, could you grab the other end of this tarp for me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure! Here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, now pull...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
It's so flatly laid out now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you some kind of tarp-laying genius, Miku-P?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd sort of rather be a genius of something else...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww, I was trying to compliment you☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Rin...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you two... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you've already gotten started.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, Luka!
Where were you both?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sorry, but we did bring some dango in return.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Here, have a look.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, those look amazing♪
Soy glaze, soybean powder, soy sauce and... Roasted ones too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shiho brought us these, so we'll have to thank her again later. For now, let's dig in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, MEIKO, wait just one moment.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's up, Miku-P?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There's still something I need to do.
Would you mind waiting just a little bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Look at that...
Plates, napkins and chopsticks for all of us...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And these cushions! Aren't they adorable?
They're so soft and comfy too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. With these, we should be able to relax very nicely while we look up at the moon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, these are perfect!
Were these always here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The girls have been having birthday parties and planetarium nights here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So they decided to leave these here because they figured that they'd use them again in the future.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'm glad they did! That's so smart of them♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was okay with just sitting on a tarp, but these do add a nice touch.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Hey, does anyone else smell something really good...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Would you all like some tea?
I'm sure it'll go well with our dango.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, me! I want some!
It's like a real party now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is this something the girls left here too?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It's Honami's, actually.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, isn't this the mug that we used during that tea party we had with Hona? I didn't know that she left these here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She did. She wanted to make it so we could have tea whenever we like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to savor every drop then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right! Anyway, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Such a beautiful moon...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it really is.
The way it glows is so majestic too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is the best!
On top of that, the dango Shiho brought us goes so well with this tea♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that reminds me of something Sakki said. Do you think it's true that there's a rabbit living on the moon?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A rabbit on the moon?
Hmm... I'm not so sure about that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's true, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! No way, really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, really. It even pounds mochi on the night of the 15th.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, why's it making mochi?!
This is starting to go way over my head!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it'd be so amazing to meet this rabbit! We could have mochi together and even do a little session♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It would be interesting to hear it play the guitar.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure that you'd get along just fine with it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, because you're Miku-P!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, MEIKO, you too...?!
Why can't I just be Miku?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha♪
